summary: At a populated model world, well-founded causal predecessors yield an actual existent with no incoming cause from another actual existent; existence-PSR adds a stipulated reason for its existence fact. Removing causal well-foundedness permits a mutually-causing pair satisfying PSR and universal external causation; removing population makes universal predicates vacuous. Explicitly non-divine and non-modal conclusion; adequacy of explanatory reasons unestablished. See docs/causal-finite-branching-and-psr-syllogisms.md. A later operational configuration adapter now exposes the already existing all_external_causes_impossible theorem as a three-listed-premise ConfigurationFalse result: selected-world population, selected-world full causal WF, and all-world EveryExistentExternallyCaused. No explanation/PSR premise is used. CONFIG-LOCAL-EXISTENCE-PSR registers it and the three-atom selection; unchanged registered EmptyWorld (drop population), MutualCauses (drop WF), and Intrinsic (drop external causation) supply the single-removal interpretations. This is reuse and propagation, not a new philosophical discovery, new model, or root-premise closure. Existing model certificates are trusted rather than rerun. The frozen CausalHarvest Challenge and single persistent-session Solution diagnostics cover this adapter; final delivered CI, not local repeated Comparator/model gates, is authoritative. 2026-11-25 (#1007): the represented occurrence argument supplies population when specialized to exactly this model/world extension. The provenance theorem retains the realizing episode of the selected assertion. A two-world control realizes the true denial of concrete population despite an existing representative here and an empty other world. Its existent fails the adopted in-re contract. Under that contract the same inhabitant supplies concrete population for the direct-esse GodExists argument, with its grounding and naming premises still required. See the #1007 section of the linked PSR note for the rival, actual-token requirement and revision test. Root comparison brings the existing representation premise into scope and discharges none.

current_assessment.scope: Issue #1007. A performed denial as a witness to population at the selected world and its use by the direct-esse argument.
current_assessment.assessment: If an episode realizes the actual assertion and its representative exists here, that representative witnesses population here. The performance gives local grounds for a token reading. Representing every occurrence requires the wider premise. The denial of concrete population can still be true when the existent fails the stipulated esse classification. Applying the selected world's existence-in-act contract to the same representative supplies concrete population.
current_assessment.next_test: For a particular denial, check whether the representation identifies this performance in the selected ontology or merely the content shared by distinct performances. Examine whether existence in act applies to that representative.
